_about: Everything specific to one league. build.py, audit.py, fetch_season.js and page.py read this; the code itself is shared.

espn._histBefore: ESPN refuses the season endpoint for 2020-2023 in this league (401), so everything before 2024 comes from leagueHistory (no lineups or transactions for 2018-2023).

name: Any Given Sunday
_pointsWildcard: From 2024 the 4th playoff spot goes to the top scorer outside the top three records (2024 bracket: Stephen Murphy 7-8 with the league's most points over Evan Schlossberg 9-6). 2018, 2021 and 2022 show it was not the rule then; 2023 can't tell.

page.title: Any Given Sunday Almanac
page.tagline: Thirteen seasons, fourteen managers, half a point per catch since day one. The league's record book.
page.loading: Loading 13 seasons of Any Given Sunday…

notes.footerGaps: ESPN keeps no weekly lineups for 2018–2023.
notes.footerSeats: A seat that passed to a new manager starts a new manager record; name changes on the same account are one manager.
notes.recordsLede: Single-week marks use regular-season games. Every season has used half-point PPR, so scores compare across the whole history.
notes.timelineLede: Champions and every rule change ESPN recorded. Marked dots show seasons where the format changed: 12 teams and six playoff spots in 2014–15, ten teams and four spots since.

site._about: Where this league is published: its folder in the repo ("" = repo root), public address, home-screen name and colors, and which repository secret holds its GroupMe bot ID.
